# Hugging Face

> The AI community building the future through open-source models, datasets, apps, and machine learning infrastructure.

Hugging Face is a platform for discovering, sharing, training, evaluating, and deploying AI systems. It combines the Hub for models, datasets, and Spaces with extensive documentation, open-source libraries, inference services, and enterprise tooling.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://huggingface.co/): Main entry point for the Hugging Face community and platform.
- [Models](https://huggingface.co/models): Browse and filter machine learning models published on the Hub.
- [Datasets](https://huggingface.co/datasets): Explore datasets for training, evaluation, and benchmarking tasks.
- [Spaces](https://huggingface.co/spaces): Discover interactive AI demos and applications built by the community.
- [Storage](https://huggingface.co/storage): Learn about storage products for datasets, artifacts, and ML workflows.
- [Pricing](https://huggingface.co/pricing): Compare plans for Hub, compute, inference, and enterprise features.
- [Enterprise](https://huggingface.co/enterprise): Overview of organizational, security, and deployment offerings for teams.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Hub](https://huggingface.co/docs): Central index for product docs, libraries, and platform guides.
- [Hub Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/index): Guides for repositories, collaboration, authentication, and Hub features.
- [Inference Providers](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index): Documentation for routed inference across supported model providers.
- [Inference Endpoints](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-endpoints/index): Managed dedicated model deployment on autoscaling infrastructure.
- [LeRobot](https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/index): Robotics datasets, policies, and tooling for embodied AI workflows.
- [Safetensors](https://huggingface.co/docs/safetensors/index): Format documentation for safe and efficient tensor serialization.
- [Evaluate](https://huggingface.co/docs/evaluate/index): Evaluation library for metrics, comparisons, and benchmarking pipelines.

## Core Libraries
- [Transformers](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/index): APIs and guides for pretrained transformer models across tasks.
- [Diffusers](https://huggingface.co/docs/diffusers/index): Library for diffusion models in image, video, and audio generation.
- [Datasets Library](https://huggingface.co/docs/datasets/index): Tools for loading, processing, and sharing datasets efficiently.
- [Tokenizers](https://huggingface.co/docs/tokenizers/index): Fast tokenizer training and inference library documentation.
- [Accelerate](https://huggingface.co/docs/accelerate/index): Distributed and mixed-precision training utilities for PyTorch workflows.
- [PEFT](https://huggingface.co/docs/peft/index): Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA and adapters.
- [TRL](https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/index): Training library for reinforcement learning and preference optimization.
- [Text Generation Inference](https://huggingface.co/docs/text-generation-inference/index): High-performance serving stack for large language models.

## Hub Guides
- [Getting Started with the Hub](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/quick-start): Introductory guide to accounts, repositories, and core workflows.
- [Repositories](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/repositories): Structure and management of model, dataset, and Space repositories.
- [Downloading Files](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/repositories-downloading): Methods for downloading repository files and snapshots.
- [Uploading Files](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/repositories-uploading): Ways to push files, folders, and large artifacts to the Hub.
- [Git vs HTTP Paradigm](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/repositories-getting-started): Explanation of repository access patterns and tooling choices.
- [Search](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/search): Search syntax and filtering across models, datasets, and Spaces.
- [Organizations](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/organizations): Team collaboration, permissions, and shared resource management.
- [Security](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/security): Security features, scanning, access controls, and best practices.

## Inference and Deployment
- [Inference API](https://huggingface.co/docs/api-inference/index): Serverless inference API for running models from the Hub.
- [Inference Providers API](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/tasks/index): Task-oriented API docs for text, vision, audio, and multimodal inference.
- [Inference Endpoints Overview](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-endpoints/index): Dedicated endpoints for private, production-grade model serving.
- [Endpoint Quickstart](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-endpoints/quick_start): Create and invoke a managed endpoint step by step.
- [Text Generation Inference](https://huggingface.co/docs/text-generation-inference/index): Deploy optimized LLM serving with batching and streaming support.
- [Transformers.js](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers.js/index): Run transformer models in browsers and JavaScript runtimes.
- [Optimum](https://huggingface.co/docs/optimum/index): Hardware-aware optimization and export tools for inference acceleration.

## API and Integrations
- [Hub API Reference](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/api): Programmatic access to repositories, metadata, and Hub operations.
- [huggingface_hub](https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/index): Python client for authentication, downloads, uploads, and inference.
- [Authentication](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/security-tokens): User access tokens and authentication workflows for the Hub.
- [Webhooks](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/webhooks): Trigger external automation from repository and Hub events.
- [GitHub Actions](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/en/spaces-github-actions): Automate Space deployments from GitHub repositories.
- [Hub Python Library Search](https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/guides/search): Search models, datasets, and Spaces from Python code.

## Tasks and Learning
- [Tasks Overview](https://huggingface.co/tasks): Browse supported machine learning tasks and common use cases.
- [Natural Language Processing](https://huggingface.co/tasks/text-generation): Entry point for text generation models and examples.
- [Computer Vision](https://huggingface.co/tasks/image-classification): Explore image classification models, datasets, and demos.
- [Audio](https://huggingface.co/tasks/automatic-speech-recognition): Discover speech recognition models and related resources.
- [Multimodal](https://huggingface.co/tasks/image-text-to-text): Find multimodal models for image-text understanding and generation.
- [Course](https://huggingface.co/learn): Learn Hugging Face tools and modern ML workflows through guided lessons.
- [Deep RL Course](https://huggingface.co/learn/deep-rl-course/unit0/introduction): Structured introduction to deep reinforcement learning concepts and practice.

## Open Source and Community
- [Open Source](https://huggingface.co/open-source): Overview of Hugging Face open-source libraries and ecosystem projects.
- [Blog](https://huggingface.co/blog): Product updates, research highlights, tutorials, and community announcements.
- [Forum](https://discuss.huggingface.co/): Community discussion board for support, ideas, and technical questions.
- [Discord](https://huggingface.co/join/discord): Community chat for developers, researchers, and contributors.
- [Daily Papers](https://huggingface.co/papers): Browse recent machine learning papers and community discussion.
- [Models Trending](https://huggingface.co/models?sort=trending): See currently popular models on the Hub.
- [Datasets Trending](https://huggingface.co/datasets?sort=trending): See currently popular datasets on the Hub.
- [Spaces Trending](https://huggingface.co/spaces?sort=trending): See currently popular interactive apps and demos.

## Enterprise and Platform Operations
- [Enterprise Overview](https://huggingface.co/enterprise): Central overview of enterprise products and deployment options.
- [Team and Enterprise Plans](https://huggingface.co/pricing): Plan details for organizations, governance, and infrastructure usage.
- [Single Sign-On](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/single-sign-on): Configure SSO for secure organization-wide authentication.
- [Audit Logs](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/audit-logs): Track organization activity and administrative events on the Hub.
- [Resource Groups](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/resource-groups): Organize access control for repositories and enterprise resources.
- [Private Hub](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/enterprise-hub): Self-hosted and enterprise Hub deployment documentation.
- [Advanced Security](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/advanced-security): Security scanning and policy controls for enterprise environments.
